$comment: IA of the local WeekSync-layout clone (placeholder brand 'Sevenday'). Derived from src/App.jsx render order and src/components/*, cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md section order. Single route; desktop (>=1024px) renders the scrolling content twice inside an infinite-loop scroller, mobile renders it once with native scroll — modelled as viewport-specific sections on one template, not as two templates, so the route total stays honest.

meta.source: Local clone at http://localhost:5175/ of the layout of https://weeksync.app/ (single-page landing)

categories.SHELL: Fixed, page-level layers that sit outside the scrolling content: scroller, navigation, overlays, consent.
categories.HERO: First-screen brand statement and primary call to action.
categories.PRODUCT: Blocks that show what the product does: the interactive demo and feature explanations.
categories.CONVERSION: Pricing, contact and closing call-to-action blocks.

shell.loop-scroller.description: Desktop-only fixed scroller that renders the scrolling content twice (wrap + wrap-clone) and wraps the scroll position for an endless loop, with damped wheel physics and 1600ms easeInOutQuad smooth jumps; disabled on mobile, where the page scrolls natively as a single copy.
shell.loop-scroller.scope: Wraps all scrolling content on the single route at desktop widths.

shell.cookie-popup.description: Fixed triangular cookie notice with a single OK button that stores a dismissal flag and unmounts instantly.
shell.cookie-popup.scope: Shown on the single route until dismissed.

shell.cursor-trail.description: Dotted SVG path following the last 200ms of pointer movement, fading out when idle.
shell.cursor-trail.scope: Desktop widths with a fine pointer only.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Fixed top menu bar with a black full-screen overlay that slides down (0.35s) listing the section anchors.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Mobile widths only (below the desktop breakpoint); replaces the sidebar.

shell.sidebar.description: Fixed left dotted-frame column with logo, tagline, Start Now button and five section links whose active state follows scroll position.
shell.sidebar.scope: Desktop widths only; hidden on mobile where the mobile menu takes over.

hero.ticket.description: Fixed desktop 'ticket' card holding the headline; scroll-linked scissors/zipper cut along a dotted line, then the ticket flies up-right rotating to -12deg and hides, revealing the content behind it.
hero.ticket.scope: Desktop widths on the single route; a spacer slide in the scrolling content reserves its scroll distance.

hero.mobile.description: Static-flow mobile hero inside animated dotted ovals (6s loop) with tagline and CTA.
hero.mobile.scope: Mobile widths only; the ticket is not used there.

product.demo.description: Interactive team-workload calendar: person rows by day columns, editable task chips with hours, drag between cells, Days/Weeks toggle, period arrows, and autonomous bot cursors that edit the schedule.
product.demo.scope: Single route, all widths (scaled frame on mobile).

product.features.description: Three stacked feature cards alternating text and illustration sides, each labelled with an 'n of 3' counter (not a carousel).

conversion.price-card.description: Black pricing card with typewritten plan title, staggered price/benefit lines and a Start Now button.
conversion.price-card.scope: Single route, left half of the price row on desktop.

conversion.contact-card.description: Beige 'get in touch' card with a short prompt and three contact-channel buttons.
conversion.contact-card.scope: Single route, right half of the price row on desktop, stacked below on mobile.

proof.reviews.description: Testimonials inside a dotted ellipse with Prev / counter / Next controls that swap slides instantly and drag/swipe via a carousel.

support.faq.description: Single-open accordion of questions, first item open on load, instant open/close with no height animation.

conversion.cta-block.description: Lime closing block with a Start Now button and a rotating wheel of sprite-animated fish driven by time and scroll direction.
conversion.cta-block.scope: Single route, all widths; contains the footer row.

footer.legal.description: Copyright line and legal links row pinned to the bottom of the lime CTA block.
footer.legal.scope: Single route, inside the CTA block.
